_note: tuned today's-rules chain plans (Track 7, GT fold); PLAN='{...}' overrides. mj/ma: MSM windows (hi, lo) per role; si: SI event ranges; blobs: [role index, target size] of the code blobs C1, C2 (merkle16rc: C3, in an MA role whose FILL it replaces, so input 0 keeps 300+ B under 10,000 B); tv2: [host role, n1] splits the variable-base tables TV (first n1 bases) / TV2 (BSB22: 11 variable bases); bindST: the GT binding in ST (else in the last SI role; no tuned plan uses it: it costs ST the op headroom of about 30 quotient words, see liveness.mjs); windows: input 0 runs 9 and input 2 runs 3 windows, so every MJ input keeps 300+ B under 10,000 B for any digit pattern (chain.mjs digitStress); wqcHost: the MA role with the second variable quotient piece WQc (default the second MA role other than the TV2 host: input 5 in every tuned plan), wqbMax: honest WQb bytes before WQc takes the rest
